title: Through the Data Management Lens: Experimental Analysis and Evaluation of Fair Classification
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. Its focus is on fairness in classification with respect to attributes like race, sex, and age.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it was not a variable or focus of the study. The analysis centered on demographic attributes such as race, sex, and age in datasets like Adult, COMPAS, and German Credit.
